Geographies Served Programs Project Pragati District Udaipur Jalore Ajmer State Rajasthan District Udaipur Jalore Ajmer States Rajasthan To enable girls who have dropped out of school to rejoin and continue their education, Educate Girls works on the project Pragati. It aims to allow girls to continue their education and clear matriculation and Senior Secondary by making use of the government's open school system. It hires and recruits ‘Preraks’ from villages and trains them to convince and motivate local families to enrol their daughters in open schools. Once convinced, the girls are registered with the open school and are continuously guided by the Prerak through learning camps to ensure retention. The girls are finally allowed to sit for matriculation and senior secondary examinations and receive their 10th & 12th grade certificates, enabling them to further be connected for skilling and employment opportunities. The beneficiaries are mostly from the age group of 14 to 19 years. Project Vidya State Rajasthan States Rajasthan Many girls attend school today, but countless others still cannot, hindered by financial limitations and societal barriers. Educate Girls, through its team of dedicated volunteers, collaborates with local communities, school staff, and influencers to change mindsets and promote girls’ education, focusing on those between the ages of 5 and 14.
